name: Clade X (JHU CHS)
description: May 2018 pandemic tabletop exercise by Johns Hopkins Center for Health Security simulating a novel engineered pathogen (Clade X) with high lethality. Senior policymakers and health experts participated, exploring decision-making under conditions of scientific uncertainty, incomplete information, and emerging global pandemic dynamics.
reputation: highly regarded in biosecurity community; part of JHU CHS series leading to Event 201
notes: Part of JHU CHS tabletop exercise series. Engineered pathogen scenario adds biosecurity and dual-use research dimensions. Open access materials available.

institutions: Johns Hopkins Center for Health Security
